what: LTR duplicate wake from mirror lag (MEASURED 2026-10-30 by Manager Session 2026-10-30c): src/runtime/live_review_due.py builds its prior-review index (cooldown, fired events, last reviewed peak) from comms/live_review/reviews.jsonl on the VM working tree (main via ict-git-sync), while reviewers write rows to the live-review/rows branch, which reach main only through live-review-rows-mirror (#21621 landed 13:47Z) and then git-sync (~5 min). Instance: pkg-64d4fa5ab0c34305 (iaum_pullback_1d, alpaca_paper) reviewed at 13:34Z (row LR-20261030T1332Z, commit 17291da, peak 2.14R); at 13:48Z the due-check still read the 2026-10-29 review (peak 1.80R) and fired new_peak @ peak 2.32R ('vs last reviewed 1.80'), so a second reviewer was spawned 16 min later (~$0.40) and the packet's previous_review field was stale. Every row written within ~15-20 min of a further price move can re-wake the same package; on real-money packages this doubles reviewer cost and shows reviewers a wrong previous_review. Fix candidates: (a) the due-check also reads rows from live-review/rows (the VM rows watcher already reads that branch for applies), or (b) record 'reviewer dispatched for review_id X' at wake-post time so the cooldown/peak baseline advances before the row is mirrored. SECOND INSTANCE 13:53Z: the same package re-woke on 'swing @ 2026-10-30T04:00Z bar' (the daily bar both earlier reviews already saw); packet previous_review still the 2026-10-29 row although rows LR-20261030T1332Z (17291da) and LR-20261030T1349Z (9c69bb8) were on live-review/rows. Three reviewers for one paper package in 21 min. Severity raised to high: on a real-money package this repeats per event kind (r_milestone, new_peak, swing each re-fire) until the mirror + git-sync catch up.
